executive_summary:
Episode 127 advances the Bride of Charlie series' preliminary-hearing record by presenting six discrete evidentiary exhibits drawn from on-air testimony and recorded interviews. The most structurally significant artifacts are the read-aloud exchanges from Officer Bagley's preliminary hearing (body-cam termination and unidentified rooftop companion), the email from a credentialed Axon Body Cam 4 operator disputing the body-cam battery explanation, the joint testimony of Sergeant Jennifer Faumuina (Utah Bureau of Investigations) and FBI agent Amanda Bakker concerning the abandoned backpack/jacket/gloves that were located on the suspect's route and then removed from FBI testing, the recorded Frank Turek FaceTime interview in which he visibly shifts his stated endpoint from "hotel" to "hospital," and a played excerpt of Dan Bongino on Megyn Kelly (Sept 15, 2025) describing the screwdriver rooftop footage as grainy.

The episode's investigative contributions are concentrated in three structural questions: (1) who was on the Losee Center rooftop between 12:23 and 12:44 and how that person's badge was verified; (2) the chain of communication by which a backpack found along the shooter route was reclassified as "Kirk's detail" without testing; and (3) the inconsistencies in Frank Turek's account of his FaceTime call during the incident. A separate tip from a verified Timpanogos Regional Hospital source advances the hospital-pre-notification question. No new evidentiary artifacts are introduced in the comments section; that material is non-investigative.

claims.label: Officer Bagley Testified Body-Cam Footage Ended While on Rooftop
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that his Axon body-cam footage, which the examiner described as 27 minutes and 35 seconds long, ended while he was still on the Losee Center roof, and said "I think his battery went dead."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Axon Body Cam 4 battery-log metadata for Bagley's device on Sept. 10, 2025, including dock-cycle history.

claims.label: Officer Bagley testified he did not know the identity of his rooftop companion
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that he was accompanied on the Losee Center rooftop by an unidentified individual in civilian clothing who had a badge and a handgun, and whose agency he did not know.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the badge-holder from rooftop footage, radio traffic logs, and officer roster records for Sept. 10, 2025.

claims.label: Officer Bagley testified he did not review video footage between 12:23 and 12:44 for other rooftop presence
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that he did not notice anyone else on the roof and, asked whether he checked the video for that gap of time, answered "In that gap of time, no"; the examiner summarized that he did not review the video for anyone on the rooftop between the suspect's jump and his arrival.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the 20-minute footage gap referenced and obtain any UVU or law-enforcement video from that window.

claims.label: Axon Body Cam 4 operator email disputes battery termination claim
claims.claim: An email from a police officer using the same Axon Body Cam 4 model states that the camera battery lasts approximately 14 hours, that cameras are docked at the end of every shift on a shared dock that uploads the data and videos to the server, and that it bothered him that the officer claimed his camera died on the rooftop.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the email author (host has protected identity), corroborate Axon Body Cam 4 specifications from manufacturer documentation, and request Bagley's device telemetry.

claims.label: Sergeant Faumuina testified backpack, jacket, and gloves were found at Fulton Library bus stop on shooter's route
claims.claim: Sergeant Jennifer Faumuina of the Utah Bureau of Investigations testified that officers canvassing the scene, including the shooter's route, found unattended items at the Fulton Library bus stops, and that a backpack, jacket and gloves were seized.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Faumuina's September 22, 2025 crime-scene overview report and the seizure item numbers she could not recall.

claims.label: Sergeant Faumuina testified items were sent to FBI lab for DNA processing
claims.claim: Sergeant Faumuina testified that the seized items were sent to the FBI lab for DNA and other analysis, along with information that the suspect may have shed items as he fled.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI lab intake documentation for these items and the chain-of-custody record.

claims.label: Sergeant Faumuina testified that testing was halted without her direct communication of the decision
claims.claim: Sergeant Faumuina testified that when the items were already sent investigators had no more information on whether they were probative, that she did not remember communicating to the lab that no further testing was needed, and that it would not be inconsistent with what she knew if FBI or ATF notes said so.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare FBI/ATF lab notes to Faumuina's communication log and identify the party that actually conveyed the "not probative" determination.

claims.label: FBI agent Amanda Bakker testified backpack was determined to be potentially left by a bystander
claims.claim: FBI agent Amanda Bakker testified that the backpack (exhibit 9) was determined to be "potentially left behind by a bystander" and that no DNA comparisons were needed at that time.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the bystander candidate; obtain the source of the "bystander" classification.

claims.label: Amanda Bakker testified lab notes attributed backpack to Kirk's detail via another lab employee's communication
claims.claim: FBI agent Amanda Bakker testified, when confronted with lab notes stating the backpack "belongs to Kirk's detailees," that this language was not from her communication log and that it was information another individual within the laboratory received.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the lab employee who authored/added the "Kirk's detail" attribution; obtain that employee's written communication.

claims.label: Host stance: FBI "bystander/Kirk's detail" determination is unsubstantiated
claims.claim: The host says Sergeant Faumuina does not remember communicating the "not probative" decision and that Bakker says someone else in the lab added the "Kirk's detail" note, asks who that person is, and says the items should have been tested.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original handwritten or digital lab note and trace the attribution chain.

claims.label: Frank Turek stated he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law during the event
claims.claim: Frank Turek stated on the played interview that he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law when the shot rang out and continued the call until reaching the hospital, with the phone in his back pocket for the duration.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain call-detail records (timestamps, duration, devices) for the FaceTime session.

claims.label: Frank Turek Corrects Himself From Hotel to Hospital on FaceTime Duration
claims.claim: In a played clip, Frank Turek says he never said he was on FaceTime for 9 hours and that someone online said he said he was on FaceTime "till we got to the hotel. No, to the hospital"; the host then says her team tracked down the person who said hotel and plays a clip.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited interview recordings and any prior statements Turek made on this point.

claims.label: Dan Bongino stated on Sept. 15 that screwdriver rooftop footage was too grainy to discern
claims.claim: Host describes watching Dan Bongino state on Megyn Kelly's show on September 15, 2025, that the screwdriver rooftop footage was too grainy for the FBI's tools to clarify, establishing a baseline against later influencer characterizations of the same footage as "crystal clear."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Megyn Kelly / Bongino Sept. 15 broadcast and any FBI enhancement documentation released between Sept. 15 and the influencer court-day coverage.

claims.label: Anonymous husband letter claims wife's Candace-influenced beliefs are causing marriage strain
claims.claim: A letter read on Frank Turek's show by an anonymous husband states that his wife has become "deeply influenced by Candace Owens' recent content" regarding Turek, Israel, and conspiracy topics, and that this is creating a widening divide in their marriage.
claims.investigative_direction: Note as Frank Turek show content artifact; not investigation-relevant. Preserve for record only.

claims.label: Verified Timpanogos Regional Hospital source states hospital was not pre-informed
claims.claim: A source verified by host as a Timpanogos Regional Hospital employee told the host that the hospital was not informed ahead of time that Charlie Kirk was en route, contrary to the official 911-call-and-pre-notification narrative.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent corroboration from hospital intake records, EMS radio traffic, and any 911-call recordings reflecting pre-arrival coordination.

claims.label: Host Says Brian Harpole Did Not Personally Identify Himself as the 911 Caller
claims.claim: The host says Brian Harpole, in his on-record statements, refers to a 911 call collectively ("we called 911") without identifying the specific individual who placed the call.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the 911-call audio and CPD/EMS dispatch records for Sept. 10, 2025 between 12:23 and 12:30 p.m.

claims.label: Host Says Blake Neff Works at Turning Point
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff is working at Turning Point, in the course of saying he claims never to watch her show yet always has a clip ready.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Blake Neff's current employment and role with TPUSA through public staff listings or his own statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's working at Turning Point.

claims.label: Host Says Coleman Flagged a Missed Hearing Segment on the Backpack
claims.claim: The host says Baron Coleman flagged to her over the weekend a part of the preliminary hearing that she had missed and that is a potential answer for why the FBI moved not to test the backpack, gloves and jacket found at the bus stop near the library.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the preliminary hearing transcript for the Faumuina and Baker testimony Coleman flagged and compare with the host's reading.
claims.transcript_snippet: the preliminary hearing that Baron Coleman flagged to me over the weekend because we were sharing notes

claims.label: Host Says Kash Patel Announced Screwdriver DNA Days After a Leak
claims.claim: The host says Kash Patel announced a couple of days later that a screwdriver carried Tyler Robinson's DNA, but that it had already been leaked that a screwdriver was discovered, which she thinks was the next day, September 11, and that Robinson was found in 33 hours.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the dates of Patel's public DNA announcement, the earlier media leaks and the FBI lab report on the screwdriver.
claims.transcript_snippet: That was announced by Kash Patel a couple of days later, but they had kind of already leaked that they were looking

claims.label: Host Says Rooftop Eyewitness Never Saw a Towel or Screwdriver
claims.claim: The host says the person who filmed and observed the figure on the Losee Center roof has kept his story and has no recollection of seeing a towel or a screwdriver, and that this was the same in her conversations with him.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the eyewitness's recorded statements and any FBI interview notes for mention of a towel or screwdriver.
claims.transcript_snippet: has maintained his story and has absolutely no recollection of having seen a towel or a screwdriver

claims.label: Host Says Bagley Reached the Roof at 12:44 and Found the Screwdriver
claims.claim: The host says Officer Bagley raced to the Losee Center roof, was there at 12:44 p.m. and found the screwdriver, and that none of the influencers' recaps of the 4K footage showed the screwdriver being taken out.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Bagley's report and evidence log for the screwdriver recovery time and location, and the footage the influencers say they saw.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's up there at 12:44 p. m. and he finds that screwdriver.

claims.label: Bagley Testified He Did Not Re-Dock or Restart His Body Cam
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that officers usually dock the body cam but that he did not go back to do so because the day was too chaotic, and he agreed the 27 minute 35 second clip is the only body cam footage he has from that day.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Bagley's device dock log and the UVU police body-cam retention records for September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: Usually dock it, but no, I didn't go back.

claims.label: Host Says Body-Cam Data Will Show Whether the Battery Died or Was Turned Off
claims.claim: The host says people who wrote in said the Axon cameras store their data, so it will eventually be possible to learn how Officer Bagley's camera battery died so quickly or whether it was manually turned off, and that she expects this to come out at a full trial.
claims.investigative_direction: Subpoena Axon evidence-system audit logs for Bagley's camera showing battery state, power-off events and upload times.
claims.transcript_snippet: it stores that data, and so we will be able to find out eventually um how that battery died so quickly or if it was manually turned off

claims.label: Bagley Testified He Brought a Backup Person Up the Stairs
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that he had somebody with him to back him up as he ran up the stairs to the Losee building, after the examiner said his body camera showed a man in civilian clothing who appeared to have a gun.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the armed person in civilian clothing from the body-cam frames and the radio log of who entered the building with Bagley.
claims.transcript_snippet: I had somebody with me to back me up as I ran up the stairs to make sure I had somebody with me.

claims.label: Bagley Testified Others Were Searching the Roof and He Learned of the Jump at the PD
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that people were up on the building looking for an individual who had run that way, because he had first been told the individual ran north, and that he only knew the person had left the building when he saw the jump on video at the police department.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain dispatch audio and CAD entries on the north-heading report and the roster of officers who cleared the building before 12:44.
claims.transcript_snippet: there was people up there looking for an individual that ran that way because when I first got told the individual ran heading north

claims.label: Host Says Influencers Reported 4K HD Rooftop Footage
claims.claim: The host says sarcastically that a ton of influencers confirmed that for the rooftop Bagley was on they are now able to get 4K HD footage that has been enhanced, and that these influencers are typically the only ones shown it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which influencers attended the hearing and what footage they say they saw; compare with the exhibit list and the footage actually entered into evidence.
claims.transcript_snippet: A ton of influencers just confirmed that that very rooftop that you were on, they are now able to get 4K HD footage.

claims.label: Host Says the Screwdriver Was Planted at a Different Time
claims.claim: The host says she does not think there was ever a screwdriver on the roof during the shooter's movements and thinks it was planted at a different time, because the official narrative cannot explain why he would take it out.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the evidence chain for the screwdriver: first officer to see it, photographs in place and any footage showing it on the roof before 12:44.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't think there ever was a screwdriver up there. I think that that screwdriver was planted there at a different time.

claims.label: Host Says the Object Swung Was a Bag, Not a Towel
claims.claim: The host says that, based on the eyewitness account from the person who recorded him, she thinks the shooter had no towel and that what is seen swinging is a bag that officials are calling a towel.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the eyewitness video and any enhanced stills of the swung object and compare with the evidence inventory.
claims.transcript_snippet: that he had a towel. I think it was just a bag. A bag that we are seeing him swing and they are telling us it was his towel.

claims.label: Host Corrects Faumuina's Agency to the Utah Bureau of Investigations
claims.claim: The host says she earlier called Sergeant Faumuina a UVU sergeant but meant to say she is from the Utah Bureau of Investigations, the state bureau.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Faumuina's employing agency and title from the preliminary hearing record.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think I said she was UVU Sergeant. I meant to say she's from the Utah Bureau of Investigations

claims.label: Faumuina Testified She Wrote Nine or More Reports Including a September 22 Overview
claims.claim: Sergeant Faumuina answered yes when asked whether nine of the reports in the larger body were written by her and that there were more, and that one report written September 22 documented the overview of the crime scenes.
claims.investigative_direction: Request all Faumuina reports from the hearing exhibit list, especially the September 22 overview and any report naming the library items.

claims.label: Faumuina Testified Officers Found the Fulton Library Items Suspicious
claims.claim: Sergeant Faumuina testified that while canvassing the shooter's route officers determined the Fulton Library stood out because there were unattended items at the bus stops away from the courtyard area, which they thought suspicious.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the canvass notes and officer body-cam from the library bus stop showing who first flagged the items and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: they determined that the Fulton Library stood out because there were um unattended items there at the bus stops that were away from the courtyard area.

claims.label: Faumuina Testified No Further Information Existed When the Items Were Sent
claims.claim: Sergeant Faumuina testified that when the items had already been sent, investigators had no more information about whether the collected evidence was probative.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI lab request form and any later communication about the items from state investigators.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um at the time when it was already sent, we didn't have more information as far as whether or not uh whe- or not the evidence that were collected there were probative.

claims.label: Faumuina Agreed It Was Fair to Say the Items Were Determined Unrelated
claims.claim: Sergeant Faumuina agreed it would be fair to say the items were eventually determined not related to the case, and the host says she is nonetheless saying the SLED determination was that they were not relevant.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who made the unrelated determination, on what information, and where it is recorded in the state and FBI files.
claims.transcript_snippet: Yeah, that would be fair. >> Okay, so the relevant thing is she doesn't remember communicating that, but she's saying the SLED determination was that it was not relevant to this case.

claims.label: Host Says the Items Could Match the Eyewitness's Description of the Shooter
claims.claim: The host says the abandoned backpack, jacket and gloves sound like they could match the description from the person she spoke to who recorded the video and said the man was all in black and everything was covered.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the item descriptions in the lab inventory with the eyewitness video and statements about the shooter's clothing and gloves.
claims.transcript_snippet: which sound like they could match the description of the person who I spoke to, who recorded the video and said, "Yeah, he was in all black, everything was covered.

claims.claim: FBI agent Amanda Bakker testified that initially there was no information from investigators, so the items, which are good for DNA, were processed for DNA.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI lab DNA results, if any, for exhibit nine and the items from the backpack, with dates of processing.
claims.transcript_snippet: Not having any information from the investigators, we processed them for DNA.

claims.investigative_direction: Check the Baker testimony transcript to see whether she said the items were initially treated as shooter-discarded or whether this is the host's inference.

claims.investigative_direction: Map the Fulton Library bus stop against the shooter route, the Losee Center and the security detail posts, and identify any detail member there.
